description: MiniMax M3 (428B mixture-of-experts, about 23B active) as lukealonso's ModelOpt NVFP4 quantization on three Sparks with vLLM tensor parallel 3 (real TP=3 through the chthonic fork's virtual head sharding), b12x attention and MoE kernels, FP8 KV, PIECEWISE CUDA graphs, 200K context and clean minimax_m3 tool-call and reasoning parsers. Basis: tonyd2wild's recipe (Apache-2.0) on his published image, with Ray and b12x master 08e980c installed at build time instead of at every start. The checkpoint's base model is under the MiniMax Community License (non-commercial use; commercial use needs attribution and, above 20 million US dollars yearly revenue, prior written authorization from MiniMax; prohibited-use appendix), shown for information. Needs a three-node RoCE mesh (upstream used a switchless point-to-point ring with NCCL 2.30u1 subnet-aware routing, and warns not to pin NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX). Upstream EAGLE3 speculative decoding (about +25 percent claimed) needs a locally padded 96-head draft and is not offered. Upstream figures (about 10.5 tok/s single stream on RoCE) are claims until measured here; Vonk physical three-Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: MiniMax M3 NVFP4 vLLM three Sparks
